title: Enhancing Clinical Classifier Robustness with Deep Representation Learning Based OOD Detection on DNA Methylation Data
abstract: arXiv:2610.36344v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: DNA methylation (DNAM) array-based tumor classification is a powerful clinical diagnostic tool, but models trained on fixed reference cohorts can produce faulty predictions for tumor types not represented in the training distribution. We propose an end-to-end deep representation learning-based out-of-distribution (OOD) detection framework for DNAm array data. Deep neural network (DNN) classifiers were trained on public sarcoma (SARC) (GSE140686) and brain tumor (BT) (GSE90496) cohorts, and feature vectors were extracted from bottleneck layers. translated_title: 基于深度表征学习的分布外检测增强DNA甲基化数据临床分类器的鲁棒性
translated_abstract: 基于DNA甲基化（DNAm）阵列的肿瘤分类是一种强大的临床诊断工具，但在固定参考队列上训练的模型可能会对训练分布中未包含的肿瘤类型产生错误的预测。我们提出了一种端到端的、基于深度表征学习的DNA甲基化阵列数据分布外（OOD）检测框架。深度神经网络（DNN）分类器在公开的肉瘤（SARC）（GSE140686）和脑肿瘤（BT）（GSE90496）队列上进行训练，并从瓶颈层提取特征向量。研究探索了五种OOD方法，包括一维子空间分析（1D-SSA）、K近邻（KNN）、岭回归、马氏距离（MD）和平方距离和（SSD），并采用了200维和500维的嵌入表示。谱差异（Spectral discrepancy）被用于区分分布内（IND）样本和分布外（OOD）样本。性能通过交叉验证、留出样本以及独立的（外部数据集）进行评估。
tldr: 该论文提出了一种端到端的基于深度表征学习的分布外（OOD）检测框架，通过从深度神经网络瓶颈层提取特征向量并结合五种OOD检测方法识别训练分布之外的肿瘤类型，从而有效增强DNA甲基化阵列临床肿瘤分类器的鲁棒性。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes an end-to-end deep representation learning-based OOD detection framework that extracts bottleneck layer feature vectors and evaluates five OOD detection methods to identify tumor types outside the training distribution, thereby enhancing the robustness of clinical DNA methylation array-based tumor classifiers.
